entities.summary: The term hyphy is an Oakland, California, slang meaning "hyperactive". More specifically, it is an adjective describing the hip-hop music and the culture associated with the Oakland area. The term was coined by rapper Keak da Sneak. hyphy is a music genre, created circa 1998. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
